test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**locomotion.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given words:
 
 
• "Relocation" means the action of moving to a new place and establishing one's home or business there.
 
• "Migration" means the movement of a person or people from one country, locality, place of residence, etc., to settle in another.
 
• "Dislocation" means displacement of one or more bones at a joint.
 
• **"Locomotion" means movement or the ability to move.**
 
 
 
• **The correct word in blank 3 will imply movement of the kangaroos.**
 
• Thus, the correct word would be "locomotion."

Hence, **the correct answer is option 4**.
